statement: The DrunkFoot surname dates back three generations to an ancestor who, drunk on night guard duty, kicked a cornerstone in exactly the wrong way and collapsed an unfinished mountain-city hall.
Three people have disappeared along the quarry-road stretch within the previous twelve days.
An improvised line briefly placed the first disappearance six weeks earlier. Discarded — conflicts with the locked twelve-day window and must not persist.
contradiction_note: Superseded by fact-tann-001; caught by the human player and corrected.

statement: A small band of deserters led by Hask Renn has been using the old drainage tunnels to rob isolated travelers.
